 All Highlights Fours Sixes Wicket UDRS 47.6 6 Nandan Yadav to Suryansh Shedge, SIX , fuller length delivery, outside off, Suryansh Shedge got under the ball and thumped it over long-off. That was a huge hit and easily sailed over. India getting a move on and how. India looking for 330 now... 47.5 Nandan Yadav to Shahbaz Ahmed, 1 run, low full toss, outside off, cue-ended down to deep mid for a single 47.5 Nandan Yadav to Shahbaz Ahmed, wide , slower ones, outside off, Shahbaz Ahmed looks to slap that and misses. Has been wided 47.4 Nandan Yadav to Shahbaz Ahmed, leg byes, 2 runs, very full, outside off, Shahbaz Ahmed sat down to slam it across the line and got it off the pads. The ball raced away wide of the keeper and the man at short third cut it off. They get a couple of runs 47.3 4 Nandan Yadav to Shahbaz Ahmed, FOUR , angled in, fuller length delivery, Shahbaz Ahmed walked across and whipped it fine for a four. That was hit wide of the man at short fine. 300 up for the Indians 47.2 Nandan Yadav to Suryansh Shedge, 1 run, fuller length delivery, outside off, Suryansh Shedge drags that down to long-on for a single 47.1 Nandan Yadav to Shahbaz Ahmed, 1 run, short of length delivery, outside off, slapped down to long-on for a single. Was not timed 45.6 Nandan Yadav to Suryansh Shedge, 2 runs, back of a length delivery, angled in, nudged down to square leg and they hare back for a brace 45.5 Nandan Yadav to Suryansh Shedge, 2 runs, on a length, angled in, Suryansh Shedge nudges the ball and gets a brace as Rinku Singh is ultra quick to come back for the second 45.4 Nandan Yadav to Suryansh Shedge, no run, short of length delivery, outside off, slapped back to the bowler 45.3 Nandan Yadav to Suryansh Shedge, no run, short of length delivery, outside off, stabbed down to the keeper off the inside edge 45.2 W Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, out Caught by Kushal Bhurtel!! The helicopter shot lands in the hands of the man at long-on. That was a very full ball, outside off, Tilak Varma got behind it and looked to whip it down the ground. But couldn't infuse too much power into the shot as that was taken at long-on. Nandan Yadav stuck to his plans of yorkers outside off and has got his reward. End of a valiant knock from the skipper of Team India A. Tilak Varma c Kushal Bhurtel b Nandan Yadav 107(113) [4s-6 6s-4] 45.1 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, no run, wide yorker, Tilak Varma slaps that down to cover. They don't get a single 45.1 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, wide , miles outside outside off and left alone for it to be wided. That was too full but too wide 35.6 Nandan Yadav to Kumar Kushagra, 1 run, angled in, on a length, whipped down to long-on for a single. The last 5 overs have seen 34 runs being scored 35.5 Nandan Yadav to Kumar Kushagra, no run, length delivery, outside off, chopped down to point 35.4 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, 1 run, back of a length delivery, outside off, patted down wide of cover for a single 35.3 4 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, FOUR , whipped for a four! That was a back of a length delivery, angled in, Tilak Varma waited on it and wristed the ball down behind square for a four 35.2 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, no run, short, wide, outside off, Tilak Varma looks to slash that and misses. That skidded on after landing 35.1 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, no run, angled in, on the pads, nudged down to mid-wicket 33.6 Nandan Yadav to Kumar Kushagra, 1 run, on a length, slower, angled in, clipped down to deep mid for a single 33.5 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, 1 run, angled in, on a length, Tilak Varma nudges the ball down to short fine for a single 33.4 Nandan Yadav to Kumar Kushagra, 1 run, angled in, short ball, pulled down to deep mid for a single 33.3 Nandan Yadav to Kumar Kushagra, no run, angled in, on a length, skidded on and has been stabbed back to the bowler 33.2 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, 1 run, on a length, outside off, patted down to deep cover for a single 33.1 Nandan Yadav to Kumar Kushagra, 1 run, on a length, at the sticks, nudged down to deep mid for a single 9.6 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, no run, wide line outside off, left alone 9.5 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, no run, good length outside off, left alone 9.4 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, 2 runs, length ball wide of off, Tilak reaches out to drive and slices it past backward point. He pushes hard and is back for two as third man cuts it off 9.3 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, no run, good length in the channel, he gets forward and defends 9.2 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, no run, hard length delivery angled into the stumps, blocked from the crease 9.2 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, wide , well wide outside off, left alone 9.1 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, no run, dropped! Lokesh the fielder slaps the ground in frustration as it pops out of his hands at gully. Back of a length outside off, Tilak goes half-heartedly on the cut, plays it in the air and Lokesh gets both hands to it as it comes at a good height. Fairly regulation chance and should've been taken. The bowler stands and stares with his hands on the hips 7.6 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, no run, back of a length delivery angled into the channel, Tilak raises his arms and leaves once more 7.5 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, no run, back of a length in the channel, left alone 7.4 Nandan Yadav to Tilak Varma, no run, well wide outside off, left alone 7.3 Nandan Yadav to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, 1 run, tries punching through the off-side and gets a thick edge that rolls to third man 7.2 Nandan Yadav to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, back of a length delivery angled in on off, Sooryavanshi punches gently to cover 7.1 Nandan Yadav to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, cutting in from back of a length, cramps Sooryavanshi for room as he tries forcing it through the off-side. His bottom hand comes off as he punches to cover 5.6 4 Nandan Yadav to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, FOUR , full outside off, Sooryavanshi hangs back, goes hard and carves it over point 5.5 Nandan Yadav to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, good length on middle and off, defended into the off-side 5.4 Nandan Yadav to Ayush Badoni, 1 run, opens the face and steers to third man 5.3 Nandan Yadav to Ayush Badoni, no run, zips through from back of a length, Badoni looks to clip it across the line but is struck on the thigh 5.2 Nandan Yadav to Ayush Badoni, no run, short of length outside off, punched to backward point 5.1 W Nandan Yadav to Abhishek Sharma, out Caught by (sub)Abhishesh Gautam!! Abhishek falls early with the ball holding in the surface again. Just not a pitch where you can play big shots, but he refuses to budge and perishes. Full at the stumps from round the wicket, he's through the slog early, skies it off the toe-end and the sub fielder - Gautam - takes an excellent catch going back from mid-on. Watched it all the way and took it with both hands as it came over his shoulder. Abhishek Sharma c (sub)Abhishesh Gautam b Nandan Yadav 9(13) [6s-1] 3.6 Nandan Yadav to Abhishek Sharma, no run, slower length ball just outside off, Abhishek goes back, opens the face and guides it to point 3.5 Nandan Yadav to Abhishek Sharma, no run, the ball is consistently holding up in the surface and Abhishek nearly chips this to point! Back of a length outside off, he tries punching it away, has to check his shot and it drops short of the fielder 3.4 Nandan Yadav to Abhishek Sharma, no run, good length around the top of off, defended into the off-side. He may have initially looking for a big shot but the ball held up and he checked his shot 3.3 Nandan Yadav to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, 1 run, back of a length outside off, Sooryavanshi waits on it and cuts down to third man 3.2 Nandan Yadav to Abhishek Sharma, 1 run, superb fielding effort and the two Indian batters are taken by surprise as they run just one! Abhishek thought it was going to the boundary. He came charging down to a length ball and lofted it over mid-off. Fielder hunts it down and flicks it back with a diving effort 3.1 6 Nandan Yadav to Abhishek Sharma, SIX , wrong line and punished! It's angling down leg from round the wicket, back of a length, and Abhishek pulls it all the way over the fine leg boundary.
